meta.units: Keys ending in F are simulation frames at 60 FPS and timescale 1.0. Keys ending in R are real 60 FPS frames and are never scaled. Ms and Sec are milliseconds and seconds. Angles are degrees, distances metres.
meta.guardLanguage: Guards are pure expressions over ctx: dotted identifiers, numbers, quoted strings, comparison, && || !, parentheses. No calls, no assignment, no eval.
meta.fallback: 2D BossArena when WebGL is absent or the lazy chunk fails

answer.kbm: W top, D right, S bottom, A left; or arrows; or 1-4
answer.pad: Y top, B right, A bottom, X left (D-Pad mirrors)
answer.touch: Tap a stone or flick from centre

penance.meleeEffect: cosmetic cracks on the current Seal

cameraShake.model: rotation = peakDeg * slider * exp(-3 * t / durationF) * noise(rateHz); overlapping presets take the stronger, never the sum; slider 0-100 percent
cameraShake.tierRule: A strike that does not land at full damage (dodged, guarded, parried) plays one preset lower than its hit preset; Perfect Parry plays S2 as a reward. TR and hit-stop are never tiered.
cameraShake.zeroPercent: hit-stop, sparks, audio and viewmodel recoil still play

hitResolution.hitTest: Every Active frame. The first frame on which the player capsule overlaps an attack volume resolves the strike. A strike resolves at most once per Active window.

order.when: geometry check passes: PGC lateral >= 2.2 m from line centre, SB and VGL player outside ring radius, DSR feet above 0.6 m on every Active frame
player.guardHeld && attack.guardable; damage = round(full * 0.3); Breath -15; Guard Break if Breath < 15

cues.note: 2.6 kHz ting, head lowered to 1.7 m, jaw open 20 degrees

feint.trapOutcome: whiff, 24 f player lockout, full damage

cues.note: lock; brass drone rises to impact
38 Hz sub-bass panned to the eruption azimuth
false click announces the lash (Module 4 f20)

phase2.chainClickLattice: 30 f offset from the beat grid
phase2.restBeforeHeavy: the Slot A before a heavy is a rest, because T0 = Impact - wind-up would fall before the measure (PGC and VGL -6, SB -30)
phase2.closingNeck: a Recovery ends on the frame before the next T0, so the neck window is cut, never overlapped
phase2.attackPairing: Module 4 section 4.4 Phase II cycle table, loaded by the Verse Director

litany.cycleRule: Exactly one question per cycle: Posture Break, or Burrow after Verse 6 if no Break occurred. A Break pre-empts a Burrow.

question.expiry: equals a wrong answer; /check is sent with choiceIndex -1

lostCause.triggeredBy: second wrong or timed-out answer (best possible 4/6)

stacking.parry: additive with Mercy: 10 + 4 + 4 = 18, capped at 18 (Module 4 section 4.1.1)
stacking.time: bonus added before the Scholar multiplier

relic.appliesFrom: next question or attack after equipping

api.headers: same CSRF-bearing helper as the 2D BossArena

body.choiceIndex: -1..3 (-1 = no answer, needs the additive backend change)

check.onFailure: QuestionActive.Silent with Retry; clock stays stopped
check.olderBackend400: play Reprisal anyway; take the explanation from submit results[]

submit.calledBy: Judgement or Reprisal that resolves the final question, or the end of the Litany of Review

body.answers: sealed answers only, built by the 2D BossArena helper; time-outs omitted

submit.retry: never blind: re-read bossStatus and re-send only if triesLeft is unchanged; payload mirrored in sessionStorage per attempt
submit.429: end the fight and return to the map
submit.serverWins: server correctCount overrides the client tally

seal_broken.firedBy: Judgement R66, or Execution f722 when one Seal remains

telemetry.durationMsDefinition: unpaused real milliseconds from boss_briefing_confirmed to the /submit request
telemetry.transport: batched, flushed with keepalive fetch on pagehide; feature-flagged off until the privacy review

neckWindow.closingNeck: In Phase II the next T0 ends the Recovery, so the window closes on the frame before it (Module 4 section 4.4); a parried Slot A cancels Slot B and the Sentinel re-enters at the next downbeat
neckWindow.visual: soft neck pulses golden once per 60 f while exposed

edu: rehearse Parry, Dash, Jump on the Training Post

audio.stems: phase stems; cajon on quarter notes, chain-click on the lattice

vfx.breath: trunk swell 3 percent over f0-f120, dust exhale at f120

Telegraph.durationF: attack.windUpF, plus the feint stall when the variant has one

enter.scheduleCues: attack.cues, anchored to T0 or to Impact; Quickened and Chastened keep each cue's distance from Impact

audio: C01 chain-click at T0 and Impact
attack-specific cue per attacks[*].cues
vfx: attack-specific tell: bronze gleam (Parry), crimson (Dash), ochre ridge (Jump), geyser ring (Breach)
Parry-now flash on cycle 1 verses V1 and V2 only (ting f36 to f66), suppressed once a Parry has landed on this boss
Telegraph.camera: tremor ramps only (S1-capped), no hit shake

transitions.note: a Break cancels the pending strike

ActiveStrike.durationF: attack.activeF; multi-hit attacks (VGL Echo Slam, DSR Twin Ridge) span first Active start to last Active end

enter.hitStopF: 3 on a landed hit or parry, 6 on a Perfect Parry

audio: C12 impact, geyser flutter or parry clash
vfx: sparks on parry (40-60), sand or ichor splatter per Module 2 section 1.3

Recovery.durationF: attack.recoveryF, or recoveryParriedF when the outcome was parried
audio: chain-click continues on the lattice
vfx: soft neck pulses golden once per 60 f
ichor streak on neck hits, sparks on other parts

transitions.note: Closing Neck: the Recovery ends here and the neck window closes

enter.hitStop: plays first and is not counted

audio: one bridle-bell toll
stop cajon and chain-click; halt the music transport
vfx: head snaps up and back, mandible slack

transitions.note: ease-in waits for landing, at most 44 f; dash velocity is damped over the 12 R drop

audio: C08 38 Hz rumble panned to the funnel azimuth
W1 at f30 and W2 at f270 on the orbit clock; hard-faded when QuestionActive begins
vfx: body arcs into the sand; S2 Thud at f24 as the mass passes under the flagstones
amber beads flare at the mend

steps.ev: tablet gathers from golden dust 2.2 m ahead
stem burns in line by line; line time = 60 / lines
answer stones rise top, right, bottom, left; 6 R apart, 12 R each

enter.viewmodel: right arm draws the Veiled Blade back; other stones dim to 30 percent

Sealed.weighingHold: if no result at R160, hold the full-draw pose while attempts continue to 5.0 s

silentOverlay.retry: press on the sealed stone; Esc offers Leave the cistern with no try lost

enter.ev: incense gutters; tablet text fades from the bottom

audio: music crossfades to the pulseless Contemplation bed on D Phrygian dominant
world SFX rate follows timescale to a floor of 0.4, low-pass 12 kHz to 700 Hz
incense tick real-time, 1.2 kHz, centred
vfx: frozen close-up debris at 15 percent speed
stone tablet, answer cross, forearm key-cap glyphs, incense timer
edu: latencyMs measured from Tablet Ready to the seal
aria-live mirror of the question text, no answers leaked

Judgement.timescale: stays 0.15 through the thrust; restore begins at R66
Judgement.origin: R0 = S160, the frame the correct result is applied

reviewVariant.plays: soft golden-dust ripple only; no Seal change, no Posture change, no Chastened; the timescale restore still runs R0-R18

timelineR.ev: chosen stone ignites gold; the other three crack and fall (R0-R11)
thrust travel, 9 W / 0.15 = 60 R; camera lunges 1.2 m
contact with the eye; hit-stop 6 R; shake S3; 800 golden dust and 400 ichor particles
restore begins (18 R); Seal n shatters
Posture set to 45; Chastened Rhythm armed for 2 attacks
timescale 1.0; the explanation is not shown on a correct answer

postureBreak.target: near eye of the head on the flagstones, 1.0 m above stone

hover.target: pale eye in the funnel, 0.1 m below the lip

audio: golden chime tail
Phase II stems fade in at music restart when entering PhaseShift
vfx: black ichor and golden dust splash; sun elevation drops 3 degrees per broken Seal
edu: explanation withheld; the student was right

Reprisal.origin: f0 = S160, the frame the wrong or time-out result is applied

reviewVariant.plays: the tail still plays as the consequence of the answer but with damage 0 and no Quickened; in later review questions a wrong answer shows only the explanation, with no tail

timelineF.ev: timescale 0.15 to 1.0 over 3 f; the chosen stone cracks black
TR T0; tail rises into the lower-left of the frame
TR Active; Vigor loss; hit-stop 3; Posture set to 0; shake S5 (45 f); concussion begins
blur clears; correct answer and explanation write themselves on the flagstones

damage.finalPassingRun: cap so Vigor stays at least 1

audio: C11 tail whoosh
2.8 kHz tinnitus for 240 f, cut 12 dB under any P1 cue
vfx: 6 px blur, 8 px double-vision offset for 240 f; heat distortion suppressed
edu: explanation delivered only after the blur clears
Lost-Cause declared when the second check result arrives

transitions.note: Execution waits for the concussion and the 360 R Reading Grace

audio: Phase II stems restart at the 240 f breather mark
storm bed band-limited 150-1800 Hz
vfx: three collar plates shear off and fall
storm vignette opacity 0.55, peripheral visibility about 70 percent

from.Judgement: starts at the end of the restore (R84)
from.Reprisal: waits for the 240 f concussion plus the 360 R Reading Grace

entry.anchor: nearest Surfacing Anchor to the player's azimuth; jaw chain loop 3.0 m ahead at 1.2 m height; head at 1.7 m

camera.base: scripted track, FOV deltas relative to the player's FOV setting
camera.reducedMotion: shake 0, FOV deltas halved, roll off

pull.rule: A heave plays its strained variant when Guard is held on its start frame +1; otherwise the auto variant. Both reach the same head pose.

drive.rule: Any Slash press in f570-f659 sets driveCommitted. The thrust launches at f636 and lands at f660 regardless.

agency.noInput: auto-completes with the base variants at identical frames

skip.flag: localStorage anees.boss5.execSeen.<userId>, written at f840, wrapped in try/catch; unavailable storage means no skip
skip.fastForward: run every effect and telemetry event with f <= 840 in order without rendering, then pose the world as at f840

audio.note: first true chain-click since the question; head-locked left
drone lifts to D major: D2 73.42, F#2 92.50, A2 110.00

water.audio: 3 HRTF emitters: pit, left springs, right springs

aftermath.replays: framed as the cistern remembering (Codex 1); same cinematic, no relic card

handoff.ifSubmitMissing: hold the f899 pose; retry with backoff over a still frame

edu: boss_result with the execution additive block
results[] lists each missed question with its explanation

timelineF.ev: light turns pale; the storm clears; HUD stays hidden
the head withdraws into the sand, unhurried
sand closes over the pit; ribbons weep gold
stillness; the lamp at the Mihrab Arch burns steady
hand-off to the results screen: missed questions with explanations, tries left, lockout countdown if any

audio: oud drone D2 and A2 only
no whisper, no tinnitus, no cajon

timelineF.ev: respawn at the south flagstones, radius 8.0 m, azimuth 180 degrees, facing north
Vigor 100, Breath 100, Posture 0; verse counter restarts; pending Chastened and Quickened cleared; answered questions stay final

audio: music low-passed during the fade
edu: a pending explanation from a fatal Reprisal is written at the respawn point
